domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers, including normalization, denominator alignment, regrouping, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize given form
skills.definition: Rewrite an operand into a more workable equivalent form before subtraction, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to standard mixed-number form or simplifying a fraction part within a mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is rewritten as a standard mixed number before subtraction.
Tag when a fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before the main subtraction.
Tag only when the rewrite changes the original representation of an operand prior to the subtraction procedure.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole part plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction rewriting done to create a common denominator; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction or final simplification of the answer.

skills.name: Decompose whole number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a whole part plus a zero-valued fractional part so it can be handled in mixed-form subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as something like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this decomposition is used to align whole and fractional parts in subtraction involving a mixed number or fraction.
Tag whether the whole number is the minuend or the subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary separation of an already-given mixed number into whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing from a whole part after subtraction has begun; that belongs to S05.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtraction.
Tag for fraction-only or mixed-number subtraction when denominator alignment is performed, even if the common denominator equals one original denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction after denominators are already aligned.
Do not tag simplification of an operand unless its purpose is denominator alignment.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping or final simplification.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like-denominator fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers or whole-number expressions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly after any needed setup.
Tag when the subtraction step produces a zero or negative fractional result before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is normalization, whole-number decomposition, or common-denominator creation.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping used to fix an insufficient fractional part; that belongs to S05.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification of the result; that belongs to S06.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to complete the subtraction directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator form and added to the fractional part.
Tag whether borrowing is shown as a separate regrouping step or embedded in the corrected subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag final combination or simplification after the borrowed subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Express the computed result in lowest terms and in an appropriate final form by simplifying fractions and combining or collapsing whole and fractional parts as needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a result fraction is simplified to lowest terms or reduced to 0 or an integer.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number, fraction, or integer.
Tag when a zero whole part or zero fractional part is removed from the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preliminary normalization of an operand before subtraction; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag the subtraction itself; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping; that belongs to S05.
